title: The stairs to the office
logline: The stairs up to Julian's office, invented: a landing, a window, a dog at the top of the stairs that isn't there — drawn faint, the way the Sunday drew it, because that's the drawing he pinned. The office door shut.

panels.composition: A narrow office stairwell from the bottom: a landing with a window, a shut door at the top, and on the top step the faint outline of a dog sitting, drawn in a lighter line than the rest.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a narrow office stairwell seen from the bottom with a landing window and a shut door at the top, on the top step the faint lighter-lined outline of a dog sitting, no people, no words
image.notes: The 2014 Sunday (the dog at the top of the stairs) that Julian pinned (ro_2022-02-20).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The dog at the top, faint.
